annotations.title: Add sitelinks, callouts, call, promotion, price, lead-form and brand assets to Google Ads

description: Add ASSETS (extensions) to a Google Ads campaign, ad group or the whole account (level:"customer") — and ATTACH them, which is what makes them show. Pass assetType plus assets[]: SITELINK {linkText ≤25, finalUrl, description1/2}; CALLOUT {calloutText ≤25}; STRUCTURED_SNIPPET {header, values[] ≥3}; CALL {phoneNumber, countryCode}; PROMOTION {promotionTarget ≤20, percentOff OR moneyAmountOff, finalUrl, promotionCode?, occasion?, startDate?, endDate?}; PRICE {priceType, offerings[3–8] of {header ≤25, description ≤25, price, unit?, finalUrl}}; LEAD_FORM {businessName, headline, description, privacyPolicyUrl, callToActionType, callToActionDescription, finalUrl, fields?}; BUSINESS_NAME {businessName ≤25}; BUSINESS_LOGO {image: a square Hermoso image}. Or link existing ones with assetResourceNames[]. Edit, pause or detach later with manage_google_ads_assets. (Google does not let apps attach Search image extensions; images go through Performance Max, Demand Gen and display ads.) Assets and links go up in ONE atomic operation, so a rejected link never strands an orphan asset, and the links are READ BACK from Google before you are told they exist. Attaching a live asset to a LIVE (ENABLED) campaign changes what that ad shows on the very next auction — show the user what would appear, get an explicit yes, then pass confirm:true. On a paused campaign it never needs confirmation.

assetResourceNames.description: attach assets that ALREADY exist instead of creating new ones

assetType.description: what kind of asset to create and attach

assets.description: the assets to CREATE and attach

businessName.description: business name, up to 25 characters; BUSINESS_NAME and LEAD_FORM

callToActionDescription.description: LEAD_FORM: text shown beside the call-to-action button

callToActionType.description: LEAD_FORM: call-to-action button type, e.g. GET_QUOTE

countryCode.description: CALL — two-letter country of the number

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency for money amounts and offering prices, e.g. USD

description.description: LEAD_FORM: description text shown on the form

finalMobileUrl.description: SITELINK — a different page on mobile

headline.description: LEAD_FORM: headline shown on the form

image.description: BUSINESS_LOGO — render id, Library id, attachment://N or Hermoso image link

languageCode.description: language of the asset, e.g. en

moneyAmountOff.description: PROMOTION: money off in currencyCode, e.g. 10 for 10 off; use this or percentOff

name.description: optional asset name in the library

offerings.description: PRICE: 3 to 8 offerings, each {header, description, price, unit, finalUrl}

price.description: offering price in major units, in currencyCode

unit.description: price unit, e.g. per month; optional

ordersOverAmount.description: PROMOTION: minimum order value that qualifies, in currencyCode

percentOff.description: PROMOTION: percent off, e.g. 20 for 20%; use this or moneyAmountOff, not both

phoneNumber.description: CALL: phone number to show, with country code

priceType.description: PRICE — SERVICES, PRODUCT_CATEGORIES, PRODUCT_TIERS, BRANDS, EVENTS, LOCATIONS…

privacyPolicyUrl.description: LEAD_FORM: https URL of the privacy policy

promotionCode.description: PROMOTION: coupon code the customer enters

promotionTarget.description: PROMOTION: what the offer is on, up to 20 characters

confirm.description: set true ONLY after the user approved changing what a LIVE campaign shows

customerId.description: 10-digit account id (dashes ok) — omit to use the brand’s selected default account

dryRun.description: validate against Google and create NOTHING

level.description: where to attach it — follows the id you pass; customer = every campaign on the account

loginCustomerId.description: manager id if operating through an MCC
